_photos: See photos_manifest.json - collage split into 14 individual images

_background_architecture.note: Live page body uses tiling curtain only. Hero is a separate baked image (see _hero_architecture).

base_tile.usage: body/.canvas background-image, background-repeat: repeat-y, background-size: 100% auto. Seamless vertical loop for the entire page below the hero.

warm_glows.note: The two lower warm light blooms approximate with CSS on the light_fixture cutout wrapper elements, e.g.: background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(230,160,90,0.35), transparent 70%).

desktop.note: Complete hero exactly as designed: curtain + spotlight + The Greatest/elesen/show lockup + microphone + date line. Rendered straight from the PSD, so it is pixel-identical to the design. Use as the hero ; do NOT layer a separate glow, lockup, mic or date on top.

mobile.note: Tighter crop of the same hero for narrow screens so the headline stays legible. Swap via <picture> media query at max-width: 1024px.

_hero_architecture.seo: Because the headline is now part of the image, index.html/registracija/aciu MUST each keep a visually-hidden <h1> with the real text. Hide with clip-path/absolute positioning, never display:none.
_hero_architecture.removed: spotlight_glow.webp deleted - the synthesised glow did not match the design geometry. The spotlight now comes baked into hero_full.webp / hero_mobile.webp.
